name: KY-019 relay
not_buildable: It needs 5 volts and an output pin, and it switches loads that are outside what LearnLens checks.
identification: Larger black PCB with a blue box-shaped relay, a blue screw terminal with three screws and 3 header pins.

facts.statement: A 5 V relay that switches when 5 V is applied to its input and needs about 15 to 20 mA. The vendor warns that work on voltages above 30 V and mains voltage is dangerous.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-019, description and technical data
